description: A conditional expression picks a shipping fee in either spelling and stays live
code:
price = 80
shipping = 0 if price > 100 else 5
label = price > 100 ? "free" : "paid"
assert(shipping, 5)
assert(label, "paid")
price = 150
assert(shipping, 0)
assert(label, "free")
shipping

description: Chained conditional expressions grade a score from the right and regrade it when the score changes
code:
score = 82
grade = score >= 90 ? "A" : score >= 75 ? "B" : score >= 60 ? "C" : "F"
level = "high" if score >= 90 else "mid" if score >= 60 else "low"
assert(grade, "B")
assert(level, "mid")
score = 55
assert(grade, "F")
assert(level, "low")
grade

description: A class rule chooses each instance status with a conditional expression and a callback follows it
code:
class Item(name, stock):
    this.name = name
    this.stock = stock
$Item.status = $Item.stock > 0 ? "in stock" : "sold out"
pen = Item("pen", 3)
cup = Item("cup", 0)
labels = Item.map(item => `${item.name}: ${item.status}`)
assert(labels, ["pen: in stock", "cup: sold out"])
cup.stock = 4
assert(cup.status, "in stock")
assert(labels, ["pen: in stock", "cup: in stock"])
labels

description: Only the selected conditional branch runs until the condition changes
code:
log = []
def note(tag):
    log.push(tag)
    return tag
ready = true
value = 1 if ready else missing
picked = ready ? note("yes") : note("no")
assert(value, 1)
assert(picked, "yes")
assert(log, ["yes"])
missing = 7
ready = false
assert(value, 7)
assert(picked, "no")
assert(log, ["yes", "no"])
value
